faq.title: Everything You Need to Know About Gahbaz
faq.subtitle: Clear answers to the most common questions about the academic platform
faq.q1: Can the platform handle multiple colleges and departments under one university?
faq.a1: Yes, absolutely. Gahbaz manages complete university hierarchies including colleges, departments, majors, and semester templates with granular permissions.
faq.q2: How are student grades recorded and GPAs computed?
faq.a2: Faculty enter scores directly into digital gradebooks, and letter grades and cumulative GPAs are automatically computed and securely archived.
faq.q3: Does the platform support real-time communication between students and faculty?
faq.a3: Yes, Gahbaz features a WebSocket-powered real-time chat system enabling students to interact with course professors and receive instant notifications.
faq.q4: Does the platform work seamlessly on smartphones and tablets?
faq.a4: Yes, all interfaces are 100% mobile-responsive, with native Arabic/English bilingual support and light/dark modes.
